parametrized_description: A computer manufacturer produces N systems, each of which is either a general-purpose (GP) or workstation (WS) system indicated by IsWorkstation. Each system i has a price Price, uses DiskDrives units of disk drives and MemoryBoards units of 256K memory boards on average. The CPU supply is limited to MaxCpu units. Disk drive supply is between MinDisk and MaxDisk. Memory board supply is between MinMemory and MaxMemory. Each system i has a maximum demand of Demand units, with total GP demand limited to DemandGP and total WS demand limited to DemandWS. There are Preorder pre-orders for each system that must be fulfilled. An alternative memory board with AltMemory units is available but only compatible with systems where AltCompatible is true. Determine how many of each system to produce to maximize total revenue.

IsWorkstation.description: Whether system i is a workstation (true) or general-purpose (false)

Price.description: Price of system i in dollars

DiskDrives.description: Average number of disk drives per unit of system i

MemoryBoards.description: Number of 256K memory boards per unit of system i

DemandGP.description: Maximum total demand for all general-purpose systems

DemandWS.description: Maximum total demand for all workstation systems

Preorder.description: Number of pre-orders for system i that must be fulfilled

AltMemory.description: Number of alternative memory boards available

AltCompatible.description: Whether alternative memory board is compatible with system i

Production.description: Number of units of system i to produce

AltMemUsed.description: Number of alternative memory boards used for system i

constraints.description: Total CPU usage across all systems must not exceed MaxCpu.

code.gurobipy: model.addConstr(quicksum(Production[i] for i in range(N)) <= MaxCpu, name="CpuLimit")

constraints.description: Total disk drive usage must be between MinDisk and MaxDisk.

code.gurobipy:
model.addConstr(quicksum(DiskDrives[i] * Production[i] for i in range(N)) >= MinDisk, name="DiskMin")
model.addConstr(quicksum(DiskDrives[i] * Production[i] for i in range(N)) <= MaxDisk, name="DiskMax")

constraints.description: Total standard memory board usage minus alternative boards used must be between MinMemory and MaxMemory.

code.gurobipy:
model.addConstr(quicksum(MemoryBoards[i] * Production[i] for i in range(N)) - quicksum(AltMemUsed[i] for i in range(N)) >= MinMemory, name="MemMin")
model.addConstr(quicksum(MemoryBoards[i] * Production[i] for i in range(N)) - quicksum(AltMemUsed[i] for i in range(N)) <= MaxMemory, name="MemMax")

constraints.description: Total alternative memory boards used must not exceed AltMemory.

code.gurobipy: model.addConstr(quicksum(AltMemUsed[i] for i in range(N)) <= AltMemory, name="AltMemLimit")

constraints.description: Alternative memory boards can only be used in compatible systems.
Production of each system must not exceed its individual demand.

code.gurobipy: model.addConstrs((Production[i] <= Demand[i] for i in range(N)), name="DemandLimit")

constraints.description: Total production of general-purpose systems must not exceed DemandGP.

code.gurobipy: model.addConstr(quicksum(Production[i] for i in range(N) if not IsWorkstation[i]) <= DemandGP, name="GPDemand")

constraints.description: Total production of workstation systems must not exceed DemandWS.

code.gurobipy: model.addConstr(quicksum(Production[i] for i in range(N) if IsWorkstation[i]) <= DemandWS, name="WSDemand")

constraints.description: Production of each system must fulfill pre-orders.

code.gurobipy: model.addConstrs((Production[i] >= Preorder[i] for i in range(N)), name="Preorder")

constraints.description: Production quantities and alternative memory usage must be non-negative.

code.gurobipy:
model.addConstrs((Production[i] >= 0 for i in range(N)), name="ProdNonNeg")
model.addConstrs((AltMemUsed[i] >= 0 for i in range(N)), name="AltNonNeg")

objective.description: Maximize total revenue from selling all produced systems.

code.gurobipy: model.setObjective(quicksum(Price[i] * Production[i] for i in range(N)), GRB.MAXIMIZE)
